gloss: body fat percentage; the proportion of fat in one's body weight

definitions.gloss: body fat percentage; the proportion of fat in one's body weight
definitions.explanation: body fat percentage; the proportion of fat in one's body weight

examples.japanese: {体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}を{測|はか}る。
{体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}が{高|たか}いと{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}{病|びょう}のリスクが{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: A high body fat percentage increases the risk of lifestyle diseases.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{体重|たいじゅう}と{体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}を{体組成計|たいそせいけい}でチェックしている。
examples.english: Every morning I check my weight and body fat percentage on a body composition scale.

notes:
A health metric indicating the percentage of total body weight composed of fat. Widely discussed in Japanese health media and everyday conversation about fitness. Many Japanese bathroom scales ({体組成計|たいそせいけい}) measure this automatically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}を{測定|そくてい}する — to measure body fat percentage
- {体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}を{落|お}とす — to reduce body fat percentage
- {体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}が{高|たか}い／{低|ひく}い — body fat percentage is high / low
- {理想|りそう}の{体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ} — ideal body fat percentage

RELATED WORDS:
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう} — body fat (the fat itself, not the percentage)
- BMI — body mass index (also commonly used in Japan)
- {内臓|ないぞう}{脂肪|しぼう} — visceral fat
- {皮下|ひか}{脂肪|しぼう} — subcutaneous fat
